# Indirect-commit scenario exercising LeaderCompletenessInv (issue #549).
#
# Scenario (3-node cluster, voters={1,2,3}, bootstrap index=2, term=0):
#   1. Term 1: node 1 wins election with node 2, becomes leader, and appends its
#      automatic no-op entry at index 3 (term 1). Its MsgApp messages are
#      dropped, so only node 1 holds entry 3 (term 1), uncommitted (commit=2).
#   2. Term 2: node 2 campaigns, wins election with node 3, becomes leader, and
#      appends its automatic no-op entry at index 3 (term 2). Its MsgApp
#      messages are dropped while its MsgVote(term=2) to node 1 stays queued.
#      Node 2 remains isolated as a stale leader at term 2 with log[2][3].term=2.
#   3. Term 3: node 1 receives node 2's MsgVote(term=2), steps down to follower
#      at term 2, and rejects the vote (log 1/3 > 1/2). Node 1 campaigns at
#      term 3, wins with node 3 (dropping MsgVote to node 2), appends its
#      automatic no-op entry at index 4 (term 3), replicates [1/3, 3/4] to
#      node 3, and commits index 4 in term 3.
#
# Result: entry 3 (term 1) is indirectly committed in term 3 on nodes 1 and 3,
# while node 2 is still leader of term 2 > 1 with log[2][3].term = 2.
# Raft Leader Completeness holds because commitTerm = 3 >= 2.

log-level info
----
ok

add-nodes 3 voters=(1,2,3) index=2
----
INFO 1 switched to configuration voters=(1 2 3)
INFO 1 became follower at term 0
INFO newRaft 1 [peers: [1,2,3], term: 0, commit: 2, applied: 2, lastindex: 2, lastterm: 1]
INFO 2 switched to configuration voters=(1 2 3)
INFO 2 became follower at term 0
INFO newRaft 2 [peers: [1,2,3], term: 0, commit: 2, applied: 2, lastindex: 2, lastterm: 1]
INFO 3 switched to configuration voters=(1 2 3)
INFO 3 became follower at term 0
INFO newRaft 3 [peers: [1,2,3], term: 0, commit: 2, applied: 2, lastindex: 2, lastterm: 1]
